links.outcome: Reading level and understandability versus actionability of chatbot neck pain responses
links.effect: Both chatbots produced responses around a 12th-grade reading level; the abstract concludes reading level and understandability likely make them learner-friendly, while actionability scores were far lower than understandability scores.
links.quote: Both chatbots produced responses around a 12th grade reading level.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates ChatGPT (v3.5 and v4.0) responses to 21 queries about neck pain for readability, quality (DISCERN), and understandability/actionability (PEMAT) without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
